copy.flight-center-away: Fly away from the sky center
copy.flight-center-help: Point each moving flight toward or away from the sky center without changing its speed or place. Resting birds and birds exactly at the center stay put. One Step back restores the whole press.

radial.message: radial preserves unrelated state and answers its supplied native experiment

copy.turn-side-help: Turn only the flights on this side of the sky. Bird places and speeds stay put; the center line belongs to the right side. Step back restores all eighty flights.

turnside.message: turnside preserves unrelated state and answers its supplied native experiment
